column1: # AQL Language Specification: the aql:minilang module + the core `mini` word
# `mini <kind> <src> <opts?>` expands at the call site to the STANDARD

# `MiniLang.kinds` lists them. NB backslashes in '…' strings need doubling
# ('\\d' below is the pattern \d) — backtick strings are backslash-safe.

column1: # Memoising an AQL kind: built-in re/xp cache their compiled artifact in a private
# Go map a kind author can't reach, so an AQL kind holds its OWN cross-call cache —
# a mutable `flex` map (module-level or closure-captured), keyed by src. CRITICAL:
# get/set quote the key, so a VARIABLE key must be parenthesised — `get (src)` /
# `set (src) v m` (a bare `get src` keys on the literal atom `src`). Here `calls.n`
# counts the compute path: 3 calls, 2 distinct srcs → the body runs twice, the
# repeat 'aa' is a cache hit. See design/MINILANG.5.md §7.

import "aql:minilang"  def calls (flex {n:0}) end  def cache (flex {}) end  MiniLang.register dbl (fn [[src:String opts:Map subject:String] [String] [if ((cache get (src)) is None) [set 'n' ((calls get 'n') add 1) calls drop  def r (add src src)  set (src) r cache drop  r] [cache get (src)]]]) end  def x ("z" mini dbl 'aa') end  def y ("z" mini dbl 'aa') end  def z2 ("z" mini dbl 'bb') end  calls get 'n'
column3: a user-registered kind memoises per src in a flex map — 3 calls, 2 distinct srcs, body computes twice (the repeat is a hit)

column1: # §7  compiled mini-languages — an optional expansion-time compile hook (design §13).
#     A kind keeps its transducer (the semantic reference + fallback) and adds a
#     compiler that runs at the `mini` site when src is concrete, splicing tokens
#     instead of the standard call. `re` ships a Go hook (precompiled-pattern
#     carrier + run-re consumer); AQL kinds add one via MiniLang.register-compiled
#     (a macro). `mini` has no expansion cache, so hooks memoize (re does).

import "aql:minilang"  import "aql:string-util"  MiniLang.register up (fn [[s:String o:Map] [String] [s]]) end  MiniLang.register-compiled up (macro [[src opts] [ quote [ unquote (StringUtil.upper src) ] ]]) end  mini up 'hi'

column1: # §mi2  MiniLang.micron — the OPT-IN user-Micron literal hook. A user kind
#       registers its literal shape as a GRAMMAR — a declarative spec Map
#       (the tabnas GrammarSpec document Parse.spec accepts) or an aql:parse
#       Parse.grammar builder value — plus a builder fn (the grammar's parse
#       result → a Kind instance, applied AFTER the parse). The grammar's
#       declared match token(s) gate the shape (the merged +m dispatch is
#       token-driven) and the grammar merges into the +m grammar BETWEEN the
#       builtin leaves and the Pathon catch-all (registration order).
#       Builtins keep their spans; unclaimed spans still fall to Pathon; a
#       token-only grammar's gates are auto-anchored to the whole literal;
#       one shape per kind, per registry.
import "aql:minilang"  def Ticketon refine Micron {id:String}  MiniLang.micron Ticketon {options:{match:{token:{'#TK':'@/T-[0-9]+/'}}}} ([s:String] => [make Ticketon {id:s}])  end  +m:T-123 typeof
